import time

import pytest


def add(a, b):
    return a + b


def test_pass():
    assert add(1, 2) == 3


def test_fail():
    assert add(1, 2) == 4


def test_error():
    raise ValueError("boom")


def test_skipped():
    pytest.skip("not here")


def test_hang():
    time.sleep(3600)


class TestGroup:
    def test_method_fails(self):
        assert add(2, 2) == 5


@pytest.mark.parametrize("n", [1, 2])
def test_param(n):
    assert n == 1
